Torus knots and knot tubes

Source: R/layers-intersections.R
stat_knot_3d.Rd

A (p,q) torus knot winds p times around the central axis and q times around the tube. The integers must be coprime. A positive radius sweeps a closed tube using the shared rotation-minimising frame.

Usage

stat_knot_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  type = "torus",
  p = 2L,
  q = 3L,
  n = 200L,
  major = 2,
  minor = 0.7,
  radius = NULL,
  sides = 12L,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments.

type

Knot family, currently "torus".

p, q

Coprime nonzero integer winding numbers.

n

Number of samples around the closed knot.

major, minor

Major and minor radii of the supporting torus.

radius

Tube radius; NULL draws a path.

sides

Number of sides of a tube.

Value

A path or surface layer.

References

van Wijk and Cohen (2006). doi:10.1109/TVCG.2006.83 .

Examples

ggplot2::ggplot() + stat_knot_3d(p=2,q=3,radius=.12,n=80,sides=8) + coord_3d()
